transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Corporate Support. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. My name is Mark Taylor, calling on behalf of Nova Retail Group. I need to speak with someone in billing about our most recent invoice.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly, Mark. I can definitely help you with that. For security and to access the account, could you please provide me with your company's Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. The Customer ID is CUST-2007.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. That's C-U-S-T, dash, two-zero-zero-seven. And to complete the verification, could you please provide the 6-digit account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The PIN is 5-0-7-4-9-8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. Just a moment while I pull up the account for Nova Retail Group. ... Okay, I have the account open. Thank you for your patience. I see you're the primary contact, Mark Taylor. How can I assist you with the invoice today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, it's a bit of a difficult situation. We've had a temporary, unforeseen cash flow crunch this month due to a delayed payment from one of our major clients. As a result, we're a few days past the due date on our last bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand, and I appreciate you calling us to discuss it. These things can certainly happen in business. Let me look at the current balance and status for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. We've been with Cymbal for years and have never missed a payment, so this is... unusual for us, and I want to get ahead of it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can see that on your account history. Your payment record is excellent. Okay, I see the outstanding invoice is for $625.00, which was due five days ago. Is that the one we're discussing?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. For our 25 mobile lines. We're not in a position to pay the full amount right this second, but we absolutely will. I was hoping we could work out some kind of temporary arrangement to avoid service interruption or penalties.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Preventing any service interruption is our priority as well. Given your account's good standing, we can definitely set up a payment arrangement. We call it a Hardship Split Payment Agreement.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, a split payment agreement. How does that work exactly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's quite straightforward. We can take the past-due balance of $625 and split it into smaller, more manageable installments that will be added to your next few regular monthly bills.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So we'd pay it off over time on top of our normal bills?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. We can split it over two, three, or even four months. What do you think would be most feasible for Nova Retail Group right now?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. The cash flow issue should be resolved within about 45 days. So maybe splitting it over two months would be best. That keeps things simple.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Two months sounds like a great plan. So, we would take the $625 past-due amount and split it into two equal installments of $312.50.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. Your next invoice would include your regular monthly charge of $625, plus the first installment of $312.50. So the total for that bill would be $937.50.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, $937.50. And the month after that would be the same?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. The following month's bill would also be $937.50. After that second payment, the past-due balance would be fully cleared, and your bill would return to the normal $625 per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds very reasonable. And this prevents any of our 25 lines from being suspended?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. As soon as we activate this agreement, a temporary hold is placed on any collection activities. As long as the arrangement payments are made on time along with your regular bill, your service will continue without any interruption.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's a huge relief. One more question... what about late fees? I assume one has already been applied.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. Let me check. ... Yes, I see a standard late payment penalty of $25 was automatically applied to the account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. Is that included in the $625 we're splitting?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Actually, since you called to make this arrangement and given your company's excellent history with Cymbal Telecom, I am authorized to waive that fee for you as a one-time courtesy.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, really? That would be fantastic. Thank you, Jessica, I really appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Mark. I'm happy to do it. So, just to confirm, you are agreeing to a two-month split payment plan for the $625 balance, and I will be waiving the $25 late fee.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what I'd like to do. That works perfectly for us.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. To formalize this, I need to process the changes in our system. It will take me about two to three minutes. While I do that, I have to read a short disclosure about the agreement. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Okay, I am now applying the credit for the late fee... and that is confirmed. The $25 fee has been removed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, I am setting up the payment arrangement. Please give me one moment. ... Okay. I'm ready with the disclosure.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ready when you are.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: By agreeing to this payment arrangement, Nova Retail Group, under Customer ID CUST-2007, commits to paying its past-due balance of $625.00 in two monthly installments of $312.50 each.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: These installments will be added to your next two consecutive monthly invoices, in addition to your regular recurring charges for service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Understood.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Failure to pay the full amount of the arranged payment by the due date of each respective invoice will result in the cancellation of this agreement.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the agreement is cancelled, the entire remaining past-due balance will become immediately due and payable, and the account may be subject to service interruption and additional fees. Do you understand and agree to these terms?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I understand and I agree to those terms on behalf of Nova Retail Group.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for that confirmation, Mark. I am now finalizing the agreement in the system. ... One moment. ... Okay, done.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So it's all set now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. The system has accepted the arrangement. Your account is now protected from service suspension, and the payment plan is officially active.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is wonderful news. Thank you so much for your help with this, Jessica. You've made a stressful situation much easier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Mark. We value your business and we're happy to help our long-term customers through situations like this. Would you like me to send a confirmation email to the address on file detailing this agreement?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. That would be perfect for our records. The address is mark.taylor@novaretailgroup.com, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the one I have right here. I'm sending that email now. It will summarize everything we discussed: the two-part payment plan and the waived late fee.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. I'll watch for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You should receive it within the next 5 to 10 minutes. It will come from a 'no-reply' Cymbal Telecom address.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me just quickly recap the key details one last time for clarity.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The past-due balance of $625 is now scheduled to be paid in two installments of $312.50. The first will appear on your next invoice, and the second on the invoice after that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your total bill for each of the next two months will be approximately $937.50, plus any applicable taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the $25 late fee has been credited back to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. Crystal clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today, Mark? Any other questions about your account or services with Cymbal Telecom?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. You've answered all my questions and solved my problem completely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm very glad to hear that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Just received the email, by the way. It just popped up on my screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, wonderful! That was fast. Please take a moment to review it and let me know if anything looks incorrect, I'll stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, let me just open it up... Yep, it's from Cymbal Telecom. Subject: Payment Arrangement Confirmation. Looks right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take your time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, reading... It outlines the past due balance of six-twenty-five... two installments of three-twelve-fifty... mentions the late fee waiver. Yep, this is exactly what we discussed. It's all correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm glad it all matches up. We try to be as transparent as possible.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you've been incredibly helpful and professional, Jessica. Please pass on my thanks to your manager. This kind of service is why we stick with Cymbal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's very kind of you to say, Mark. I'll be sure to add a note to your account reflecting your positive feedback. We truly appreciate your business and your loyalty.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. Well, that's all from me. Thanks again for everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome. If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to call us back.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Will do. Have a great day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, Mark. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Goodbye.
